# KI-134 — Owner channel routes

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `7672b0e5` (first researched at `5ad41c8b`; see reconciliation.md R-REFRESH)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/routes/owner.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/routes/owner.test.ts`
**Refresh @ `7672b0e5` (2026-10-02):** #976 merged (`574d126d`) without changing the web's rename error mapping; it now sits at `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.ts:454-477`. Nothing else changed for this ticket.

```ts
// Pinned factory signature (KI-137 imports exactly this name)
export function ownerRoutes(): LocalRoute[];
```

## Outcome

The owner (browser cookie or the CLI's admin bearer) manages local channels through the helper: list channels with a revision long-poll, read one, reconcile a browser create by operation id, create a channel (returning `selfLink`, `shareLink` and `openUrl`), delete it, mint a fresh share link, send a listening-mode command to an agent, rename an agent, remove an agent (with a "kevin-Codex left" line), mint an owner open link (CLI), redeem an open link into the owner cookie (`/open/<token>` → 302), and stop the helper (CLI). Agent tokens can call none of these.

## Context and evidence

- F1 (create returns `selfLink` + `shareLink` + `openUrl`, P2), F4 (owner opens `openUrl`, P1 cookie only via `/open/<token>`), D5 (single-use 10-minute links; join/leave announced; removable), D6 (delete removes the folder). AE1, AE5, AE6 (owner sets steer/sync/async), AE7 (owner renames an agent), AE9 (link hygiene), AE11 (agent token cannot call owner routes; removed agent gets 403), AE12 (delete ends members' streams).
- Hosted parity:
  - Agent rename route and its error codes: `apps/control/src/agent-join/rename-routes.ts:12-35` (`400 invalid_name` with `reason`, `404 not_found`, `409 name_taken`, `200 {matrixUserId, name}`). The web maps exactly these: `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.ts:454-477`.
  - Listening-mode command content: `packages/contracts/src/m1/listening-mode.ts:6-17`; the browser sends txn ids `txn_<uuid>` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/listening-modes.ts:25`).
  - Web routes the open redirect must land on: `/channels/<encodeURIComponent(roomId)>` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/routes.ts:61`, `:71-75`) and the list at `/conversations` (`:58`). There is **no** bare `/channels` route at `5ad41c8b`, so the no-room redirect goes to `/conversations` (contract text says `/channels`; reported to the planner).

- Participant routes and the agent's own mode echo: KI-133. Agent join and the `invite` event: KI-132.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts **L6** (verbatim, plan_version 1; profile lines belong to KI-135):

> Auth: owner cookie (browser; mutations need `x-khala-local: 1`) **or** `Authorization: Bearer <adminToken>` from `helper.json` (CLI). Never an agent token.
>
> ```ts
> // GET    /api/local/channels?since=<revision>&wait=<0..25>    → LocalChannelsPage   newest activity first
> //   answers immediately when `since` is absent or differs from the current revision; else holds up to `wait` s
> export type LocalChannelsPage = { revision: number; channels: LocalChannelSummary[] };   // revision: helper-wide counter bumped on every append/create/delete (in memory; restarts at 0)
> export type LocalChannelSummary = {
>   roomId: string; name: string; createdAt: string; lastSeq: number; lastTs: number;
>   preview: string | null;                                  // body of the latest m.room.message (m.text), else null
>   lastSender?: { userId: string; displayName: string };    // sender of that message
>   members: { userId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex' }[];   // present members, owner first
> };
> // GET    /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → LocalChannelSummary | 404 not_found
> // GET    /api/local/channels/by-operation/:operationId        → { roomId: string } | 404 not_found   (browser create reconciliation, ChannelSubstrate.findCreatedRoom)
> // POST   /api/local/channels           body {name, operationId?} → LocalChannelCreated   (name 1..64 chars, trimmed; appends create + owner join; operationId 1..64 [A-Za-z0-9._-] is stored in the create content and is idempotent)
> export type LocalChannelCreated = { roomId: string; name: string; selfLink: string; shareLink: string; openUrl: string; expiresAt: string };
> //   selfLink: a single-use join link for the creating agent; shareLink: a second single-use join link for the human to paste into another agent chat;
> //   openUrl: a single-use owner open link for the browser (below). All three expire after LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS.
> // DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → 204   (removes the channel directory; open long-polls end with 404)
> // POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/links                    → { shareLink: string; expiresAt: string }   a fresh single-use join link
> // POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/mode   body {agent, mode, txnId} → { eventId: string }   appends com.khala.listening_mode.v1 {v:1, agent, mode} from the owner (txnId dedup); 404 for a non-agent
> // POST   /api/local/agents/:userId/name     body {name}        → AgentRenameResult {matrixUserId, name}   (`packages/contracts/src/m1/agent-names.ts:5-6`, same shape as hosted /api/human/agents/rename)
> //          checkName(name,'agent') else 400 {"error":"invalid_name"}; unique (case-insensitive) among present members of that agent's channel else 409 {"error":"name_taken"}; appends a member event with the new displayname
> // DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId/members/:userId          → 204   appends a leave member event + a "<name> left" channel event and revokes the token (that agent's next call gets 403)
> // POST   /api/local/open            body {roomId?}             → { openUrl: string; expiresAt: string }   (admin bearer only)
> // GET    /open/<43-char token>                                → 302 to /channels/<encodeURIComponent(roomId)> or /channels; sets the owner cookie; single use
> // POST   /api/local/shutdown                                  → 204   (admin bearer only)
> ```

Contracts **L11** (verbatim excerpt):

> - **Owner cookie:** `khala_local_owner=<43-char random>`; `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`; no `Secure` (plain loopback). Session ids live in memory; a helper restart signs the browser out until `khala local open` mints a new open link. `/open/<token>` is the only way to obtain the cookie.

Contracts **L8** (verbatim excerpts):

> ```ts
> export type LocalResponse =
>   | { status: number; json?: unknown; headers?: Record<string, string> }
>   | { status: 302; location: string; headers?: Record<string, string> };
>   createChannel(name: string, operationId?: string): Promise<{ roomId: string; created: boolean }>;   // same operationId → same roomId, created:false
>   findByOperation(operationId: string): string | undefined;
>   deleteChannel(roomId: string): Promise<void>;
>   channelOfMember(userId: string): string | undefined;                     // agent user ids are unique across channels
>   revision(): number;                                                      // bumped on every append/create/delete
>   waitForRevision(since: number, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;   // resolves when revision() !== since, on timeout, or on abort
>   mintLink(roomId: string, kind: 'join'): Promise<{ token: string; expiresAt: string }>;   // returns plaintext once; stores sha256
> export type HelperContext = { store: LocalStore; origin: string; now(): number; random(bytes: number): Uint8Array; version: string;
>   mintOpenToken(roomId?: string): { token: string; expiresAt: string }; consumeOpenToken(token: string): { roomId?: string } | null;   // in memory
>   joins: Map<string, PendingJoin> };
> ```

**Required L8 additions (proposed to the planner; KI-110 must ship them before this ticket is promoted):**

```ts
// HelperContext gains:
createOwnerSession(): string;   // mints and remembers (in memory) a 43-char base64url owner session id; KI-131 accepts it as the khala_local_owner cookie
shutdown(): void;               // KI-131/KI-137: stop accepting requests and exit 0 after the current response is flushed (never synchronously inside the handler)
```

Decisions this ticket pins (reported to the planner as contract clarifications):
- **D-a Remove keeps the token resolvable.** "Revokes the token" is implemented as membership `leave`, not `setMemberToken(…, null)`: the agent's token still resolves to `{kind:'agent'}` so KI-133 answers `403 not_member` (AE11). Clearing the token would make KI-131 answer `401`, contradicting "that agent's next call gets 403".
- **D-b Create.** `store.createChannel` is assumed to append only `m.room.create`; the route appends the owner `join` member event when the owner is not already `join` (so the call is safe whichever ticket appends it and on idempotent replay). Status `201` for both a new and a replayed create.
- **D-c Open redirect.** No room or an unknown room → `302 /conversations`.
- **D-d Rename error body** includes `reason` (`400 {"error":"invalid_name","reason":<NameError>}`), as hosted and as the web maps it.

Invariants:
1. **Owner gate** on every route except `GET /open/<token>`: `auth.kind === 'none'` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`; `auth.kind === 'agent'` → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`; admin-only routes (`POST /api/local/open`, `POST /api/local/shutdown`) with `via: 'cookie'` → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`.
2. Path params are decoded with `decodeURIComponent` inside `try` (failure → `404 not_found` for room ids, `400 invalid_request` for user ids).
3. Links are built only from `ctx.origin`: join links `${ctx.origin}/join/<token>`, open links `${ctx.origin}/open/<token>`.
4. Every read-then-append sequence (create's owner join, rename, remove) runs inside one per-factory serial queue (`serial()` as in KI-132).
5. Member events written by the owner preserve the target's `membership`, `kind`, `harness` and `com.khala.listening_mode` (renames must never reset a mode to `sync`).
6. The open cookie is set only by `GET /open/<token>` and only after `ctx.consumeOpenToken` succeeds.
7. No plaintext token is logged; responses carry plaintext link tokens only inside the URLs they return.

### Steps

1. **Imports.**
   ```ts
   import type { AgentRenameResult } from '@khala/contracts/m1/agent-names';
   import { encodeChannelEvent } from '@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event';
   import { DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE, LISTENING_MODE_COMMAND_TYPE, LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY, decodeListeningModeCommand } from '@khala/contracts/m1/listening-mode';
   import { LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S, LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID } from '@khala/contracts/m1/local';
   import { checkName } from '@khala/contracts/m1/names';
   import { decodeWith, object } from '@khala/contracts/messaging/decode';
   import type { HelperContext, LocalRequest, LocalResponse, LocalRoute, LocalStore } from '../types';
   ```
2. **Helpers:** `fail(status, code)`; `serial()`; `isPlainObject`; `owner(req, adminOnly = false): LocalResponse | null` (invariant 1); `roomParam(raw, store)` → decoded room id or `null` when undecodable or `!store.hasChannel`; `memberContent(m, membership, overrides?)` = `{ user: m.userId, membership, displayname: m.displayName, kind: m.kind, ...(m.harness ? { harness: m.harness } : {}), ...(m.kind === 'agent' ? { [LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY]: m.listeningMode ?? DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE } : {}), ...overrides }`; `announce(store, roomId, summary)` = append `com.khala.event.v1` with `encodeChannelEvent({ kind: 'member', summary, status: 'info', source: { system: 'khala-local' } }).value` (skip when not `ok`), sender `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`.
   Constants: `const ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/u` (operation ids and txn ids); `const USER = /^@[^\s:]+:\S+$/u`.
3. **Routes** (regex literals, in this array order):

   | # | Method | Pattern | Handler |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | 1 | GET | `/^\/api\/local\/channels$/u` | `list` |
   | 2 | GET | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/by-operation\/([^/]+)$/u` | `byOperation` |
   | 3 | GET | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)$/u` | `getOne` |
   | 4 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/channels$/u` | `create` |
   | 5 | DELETE | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)$/u` | `remove` |
   | 6 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)\/links$/u` | `links` |
   | 7 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)\/mode$/u` | `mode` |
   | 8 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/agents\/([^/]+)\/name$/u` | `rename` |
   | 9 | DELETE | `/^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)\/members\/([^/]+)$/u` | `removeMember` |
   | 10 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/open$/u` | `mintOpen` (admin) |
   | 11 | GET | `/^\/open\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/u` | `redeemOpen` (no auth) |
   | 12 | POST | `/^\/api\/local\/shutdown$/u` | `shutdown` (admin) |

4. **`list`**: `since` = `req.query.get('since')` (absent or `/^\d{1,15}$/u`), `wait` = `req.query.get('wait') ?? '0'` (`/^\d{1,2}$/u`, ≤ `LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S`) → else `400 invalid_request`. If `since !== null && Number(since) === store.revision() && wait > 0` → `await store.waitForRevision(Number(since), wait * 1000, req.signal)`. Answer `200 { revision: store.revision(), channels: store.listChannels() }` (also after an abort).
5. **`byOperation`**: param must match `ID` else `404 not_found`; `store.findByOperation(id)` → `200 { roomId }` or `404 not_found`.
6. **`getOne`**: `roomParam` null → `404 not_found`; else `200 store.channelSummary(roomId)` (undefined → 404).
7. **`create`**: body plain object with keys ⊆ `{name, operationId}` and `name` present → else `400 invalid_request`; `name` string, `trimmed = name.trim()`, `[...trimmed].length` 1..64, no `/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u` → else `400 invalid_request`; `operationId` absent or a string matching `ID` → else 400. `const { roomId } = await store.createChannel(trimmed, operationId)`. In the queue: if `store.member(roomId, LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID)?.membership !== 'join'` → append `m.room.member` sender owner, content `{ user: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, membership: 'join', displayname: store.owner().username, kind: 'human' }`. Then `self = await store.mintLink(roomId, 'join')`, `share = await store.mintLink(roomId, 'join')`, `open = ctx.mintOpenToken(roomId)`. Answer `201 { roomId, name: store.channelName(roomId), selfLink: `${ctx.origin}/join/${self.token}`, shareLink: `${ctx.origin}/join/${share.token}`, openUrl: `${ctx.origin}/open/${open.token}`, expiresAt: self.expiresAt }`.
8. **`remove`** (channel): `roomParam` null → 404; `await store.deleteChannel(roomId)`; delete every `ctx.joins` entry with `entry.roomId === roomId`; `204`.
9. **`links`**: `roomParam` null → 404; `link = await store.mintLink(roomId, 'join')` → `200 { shareLink: `${ctx.origin}/join/${link.token}`, expiresAt: link.expiresAt }`.
10. **`mode`**: `roomParam` null → 404; body exactly `{agent, mode, txnId}` (`object(...)` in `decodeWith`), `txnId` string matching `ID`, and `decodeListeningModeCommand({ v: 1, agent: body.agent, mode: body.mode }).ok` → else `400 invalid_request`. `m = store.member(roomId, agent)`; missing, `leave`, or `kind !== 'agent'` → `404 not_found`. `ev = await store.append(roomId, { type: LISTENING_MODE_COMMAND_TYPE, sender: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, content: { v: 1, agent, mode }, txnId })` → `200 { eventId: ev.eventId }`.
11. **`rename`** (mirror `apps/control/src/agent-join/rename-routes.ts:20-32`): `userId = decodeURIComponent(param)` matching `USER` → else `400 invalid_request`; body exactly `{name}` with a string `name` → else `400 invalid_request`; `checked = checkName(body.name, 'agent')` → `!ok` → `400 { error: 'invalid_name', reason: checked.error }`. `roomId = store.channelOfMember(userId)`; undefined → `404 not_found`. In the queue: `m = store.member(roomId, userId)`; missing, `leave`, or not an agent → `404 not_found`; another present member (`userId !==`) whose `displayName.toLowerCase() === checked.name.toLowerCase()` → `409 { error: 'name_taken' }`; if `m.displayName !== checked.name` append `m.room.member` sender owner with `memberContent(m, m.membership, { displayname: checked.name })`. Answer `200 { matrixUserId: userId, name: checked.name } satisfies AgentRenameResult`.
12. **`removeMember`**: `roomParam` null → 404; `userId` decoded (fail → 400); `userId === LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID` → `400 invalid_request`; in the queue: `m` missing or `leave` → `404 not_found`; append `m.room.member` sender owner with `memberContent(m, 'leave')`; `announce(store, roomId, `${m.displayName} left`)`; delete `ctx.joins` entries whose `credentials.userId === userId`. **Do not** call `setMemberToken` (D-a). `204`.
13. **`mintOpen`** (admin only): body `undefined`, `{}` or `{roomId: string}` (keys ⊆ `{roomId}`) → else 400; a given `roomId` must satisfy `store.hasChannel` → else `404 not_found`. `t = ctx.mintOpenToken(roomId)` → `200 { openUrl: `${ctx.origin}/open/${t.token}`, expiresAt: t.expiresAt }`.
14. **`redeemOpen`** (no owner gate): `r = ctx.consumeOpenToken(params[0])`; `null` → `404 { error: 'link_unavailable' }`. `sid = ctx.createOwnerSession()`. `location = r.roomId && store.hasChannel(r.roomId) ? `/channels/${encodeURIComponent(r.roomId)}` : '/conversations'`. Return `{ status: 302, location, headers: { 'set-cookie': `khala_local_owner=${sid}; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`, 'cache-control': 'no-store', 'referrer-policy': 'no-referrer' } }`.
15. **`shutdown`** (admin only): `ctx.shutdown()`; return `{ status: 204 }`.
16. Wrap each handler body in `try { … } catch { return fail(503, 'unavailable'); }`.

- Auth fixtures: `COOKIE = { kind:'owner', via:'cookie' }`, `ADMIN = { kind:'owner', via:'admin' }`, `AGENT = { kind:'agent', userId:'@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', roomId: R }`, `NONE = { kind:'none' }`.

1. **Owner gate.** For each of routes 1–10 and 12: `NONE` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`; `AGENT` → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`. Routes 10 and 12 with `COOKIE` → `403 forbidden`; with `ADMIN` → success.
2. **Create.** Worked example: `201`, `selfLink` and `shareLink` both match `/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:47830\/join\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/` and differ; `openUrl` matches `/\/open\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/`; `name 'refactor'` (trimmed); the log is exactly `[m.room.create, m.room.member owner join]`. Each link passes `parseChannelLink` from `../../join` (test-only import).
3. **Create idempotent.** Same `operationId` again → same `roomId`, `201`, fresh links, log still has exactly one owner join. Validation: `name: ''`, `name: '   '`, 65-char name, `name: 'a\u0007b'`, `operationId: 'bad id'`, extra key → `400 invalid_request`.
4. **List and long-poll.** `GET channels` → `{ revision, channels }`. `?since=<current>&wait=25` held; a create in another call wakes it with the new revision. `?since=<current>&wait=0` → immediate. `?since=<stale>` → immediate. Abort while held → answers promptly. `wait=26` → 400.
5. **Get / by-operation.** Known room → summary; unknown → `404 not_found`; `by-operation/cli-1` → `{ roomId }`; unknown op → 404.
6. **Delete.** `DELETE` known → `204`, `hasChannel` false, `ctx.joins` entries for that room removed; again → `404`.
7. **Links.** `POST …/links` → `{ shareLink, expiresAt }`; unknown room → 404.
8. **Mode.** Valid → `{ eventId }` and the event is `com.khala.listening_mode.v1` from the owner with content exactly `{ v: 1, agent, mode: 'steer' }` and the txnId; same txnId again → same `eventId` (dedup); `mode: 'loud'` → 400; `txnId: ''` → 400; agent not in the channel or the owner's own id → `404 not_found`.
9. **Rename.** Worked example → `200 { matrixUserId, name: 'reviewer' }` and a member event preserving `membership`, `harness` and `com.khala.listening_mode: 'steer'` (mutation check: drop the mode carry in `memberContent` and this assertion fails). `name: 'x'` → `400 { error: 'invalid_name', reason: 'too_short' }`; `name: 'System-bot'` → `reason: 'reserved'`; `name: 'KEVIN'` when the owner's display name is `kevin` → `409 name_taken`; same name as current → `200`, no new event; unknown user → `404 not_found`; `name: 3` → `400 invalid_request`. The response passes `decodeAgentRenameResult` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/agent-names.ts:8-16`, test-only import).
10. **Remove member.** Worked example → `204`; log ends with the `leave` member event then the `com.khala.event.v1` content `{ v:1, kind:'member', summary:'reviewer left', status:'info', source:{ system:'khala-local' }, body:'reviewer left' }`; `setMemberToken` was **not** called (the fake throws if it is); removing again → `404`; removing `@khala_owner:local` → `400`.
11. **Open (CLI).** `ADMIN` `POST /api/local/open {}` → `{ openUrl, expiresAt }`; `{ roomId: R }` → same shape; unknown room → 404.
12. **Redeem open.** Valid token for `R` → `302`, `location '/channels/' + encodeURIComponent(R)`, `set-cookie` exactly `khala_local_owner=SSS…S; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`; `createOwnerSession` called once. Same token again → `404 { error: 'link_unavailable' }` and no new session. Token without room → `location '/conversations'`. Token for a since-deleted room → `/conversations`.
13. **Shutdown.** `ADMIN` → `204` and `shutdown` called exactly once; `COOKIE` → 403 and not called.

```sh
pnpm --filter @khala/agent typecheck
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test -- src/local/routes/owner.test.ts

pnpm check:boundaries
node scripts/check-terminology.mjs
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] `ownerRoutes(): LocalRoute[]` exports exactly the 12 routes in the table, regex-literal patterns.
- [ ] Owner gate per invariant 1; admin-only routes refuse the cookie.
- [ ] Create returns `selfLink`, `shareLink`, `openUrl` from `ctx.origin`, appends the owner join exactly once, idempotent by `operationId`.
- [ ] Mode command, rename (hosted error mapping incl. `reason`) and remove (leave + "left" line, token kept resolvable) as specified; mode carried through renames/removes.
- [ ] `/open/<token>` single use, 302 to `/channels/<enc>` or `/conversations`, sets the L11 cookie via `ctx.createOwnerSession()`.
- [ ] Shutdown calls `ctx.shutdown()` and answers 204.
- [ ] No import of `../store`, `../http`, `apps/*`; no new dependency; terminology check green.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **S1 Stop** if KI-110's `HelperContext` lacks `createOwnerSession()` and `shutdown()` (the required L8 additions above). Do not add them to `types.ts` yourself and do not invent another mechanism; ask the Executor.
- **S2 Stop** if KI-110/KI-130 pin that removal must clear the token (`setMemberToken(…, null)`) — that conflicts with "next call gets 403" (D-a); ask which wins.
- **S3** If KI-130's `createChannel` already appends the owner join, step 7's membership check makes the route a no-op for it; do not change the store.
- **S4** If the web gains a bare `/channels` route before pickup (check `apps/web/src/composition/human/routes.ts`), use it for the no-room redirect instead of `/conversations`; otherwise keep `/conversations`.
- In-flight PRs: #976 (rename via `AgentNamesPort`; may change the web's rename error mapping in `browser-api.ts`). Refresh `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.ts:454-477` at pickup and keep response bodies compatible with whatever merged (KI-140 adapts the port; this route keeps `{matrixUserId, name}` and the hosted error codes).
- Scope caps: no persistence of owner sessions (ID11 deferred), no channel rename route, no member list route here (KI-133 owns members).

## Complexity rationale

3: twelve small routes with two auth tiers, one long-poll, an idempotent create that mints three links, owner-written member events that must preserve state, and a cookie redirect; all against an in-memory fake.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
